moments.title: Chart History for Sam Fender & Olivia Dean
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' has broken a 73-year record to become the longest-running Official UK Number 1 single ever, with 19 non-consecutive weeks at the top.

angles.name: Record Breaker
angles.copy: History made! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' is officially the longest-running UK Number 1 single EVER. What a track!

angles.name: Fender & Dean Fan Reaction
angles.copy: 19 weeks at Number 1! Sam Fender and Olivia Dean are owning the charts. Is 'Rein Me In' your favourite Number 1 of all time?
